item.text: The reconnaissance has established a closed, one-party information environment with strong formal party authority, a 2022 recovery program and measurable social outcomes, continued repression, an active anti-corruption drive, and limited nuclear exposure under IAEA safeguards. I’m now consolidating reusable claims across chapters and preserving contrary implementation and attribution caveats.

Research pass completed. Files could not be written because the workspace is read-only; the complete handoff is below for parent persistence.

### Reconnaissance

- Nguyễn Phú Trọng held the dominant party position in 2022; Freedom House records his exceptional third-term reelection and CPV control over executive selection and elections. [Freedom House](https://freedomhouse.org/country/vietnam/freedom-world/2022)
- The information environment was closed: censorship, activist persecution, controlled elections, and limited independent scrutiny were documented by Freedom House, HRW, Amnesty, and the US State Department. [HRW](https://www.hrw.org/news/2022/02/17/vietnam-activists-movements-blocked), [US State Department report](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2089144.html)
- Authority was formal and practical through the CPV, Politburo, Central Committee, and anti-corruption steering apparatus. In November 2022, Trọng chaired the central anti-corruption body and reviewed hundreds of cases and senior disciplinary actions. [Vietnam Government Portal](https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-ket-luan-cua-tong-bi-thu-nguyen-phu-trong-tai-cuoc-hop-phong-chong-tham-nhung-tieu-cuc-119221118204327577.htm)
